dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: It's quite different from Aaru Village, but I feel at ease here nonetheless.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: I was so surprised the first time I came in. Such a small teapot, and yet so vast on the inside...

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: If I could store Aaru Village in a teapot...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: I was simply musing. Even if that were possible, what I seek to protect is not an object named Aaru Village...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: ...It is my homeland and the lives of everyone in it.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: My apologies for making you listen to all this...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: And, thank you for having me.

choices.text: That would definitely make things more convenient...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Hmm... If I could easily take everyone someplace else...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: No, I suppose they wouldn't agree to leaving the desert in the first place.
